Name: Trigun Replacements
Author: KiwimeWo
Description:
Uses SMAPI and Content Patcher (both from Pathoschild) to alter sprites, dialogues, and portraits.

Sam, and any reference of him, will be replaced with Vash the Stampede from Trigun '98
Similarly, Sebastian will be replaced with Wolfwood from Trigun '98.

Some dialogues have been altered further to include references from the anime.

Schedules, locations, and other relationships remain the same as in base Stardew


To Install:

Make sure to have up to date SMAPI and Content Patcher

Download The file

Add to your stardew valley mods folder 

Unzip file

Manifest.Name: Trigun Replacements
Manifest.Description: Replaces sams model with Vash from anime Trigun, and Sebastian with Wolfwood
